text_block_list.text:
One day, after Найс Нэйчер has a number
of
victories under her belt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Тренер? Do you have a minute?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when we won that hot
spring
vacation coupon? Whatever
happened to it?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's talking about the grand-prize we
won
together in a raffle. Technically, she
gave it to me
to use, but I've been
holding on to it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Really? Then... would it be okay if I use
it?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You know, it's kinda sad that I can't go
even
though I won the coupon too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I like hot springs, after all. In fact, I love
hot
springs! I thought it'd be nice to
relax a bit, you
know what I mean?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: So... can I?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wooh—er, great. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right, then we should sort out
scheduling now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: So who are you going with?

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: With you, of course! Hello?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Finally.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
After some planning and travel time, we

eventually find ourselves at the hot
spring
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is acting a bit awkward. It
might be
because I initially didn't realize
she was inviting
me here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sooo...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Apparently this hot spring has lots of
health
benefits. Why don't we go for a
soak real quick?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After getting out of the hot spring, I'm
relaxing in
my room, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's me. Can I come in?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ummm... The water was really nice,
wasn't it?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! It soothed me down to
my core.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All the pent-up stress in my shoulders
and back?
Gone, just like that!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...How about you?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's good. It's a good thing we came
here...
right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Yeah. Thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.text: ...Don't say it like that.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You could just say you wanted to come
here with
me too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You could just say you wanted to come
here with
me too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for inviting me" sounds like
you don't
really care if we came
together or not.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Like... I'm the only one who cares.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I don't knoooow. You're avoiding eye
contact.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. I'm being weirdly clingy
right now. I
wouldn't blame you if you
think I'm annoyi—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...If you say sooo.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: What should I do to make you believe me?

text_block_list.text: Trophy.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I'd like a floppy trophy.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's supposed to be reward for
hard work,
right? I just thought it'd be
nice to have one for a
general job
well-done...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
So... make one right here, right now. You
have a
notepad or some paper, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Where else?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? That makes me want to see it
even
more!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm always the one who showing my
vulnerable
side. Don't you think it's a bit
unfair?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll sit next to you and watch.
I hope
you're ready to make a
masterpiece.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
With the occasional interruption from
Nice
Nature, I make her requested
trophy and present
it to her. As for the
quality... Well, it made her
laugh, so I'll
consider it a success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I sense that Найс Нэйчер and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during our
time together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
